values.subject: Ximing Semiconductor: ESPP shortfall plan and signing schedule (confirm by Jun 22)
values.body_text:
Hello Bian Ling,

For the vested equity redemption at your departure, the company proposes a fixed internal price totaling CNY 200,300 before tax. The company does not accept the fair-market-price basis and will use its proposal.

Please reply by June 22, 2026 and sign the negotiated employment separation agreement with HR. The agreement also contains a two-year post-employment non-compete clause.

Lu Qian, HR
